litigation_status: One verified federal appellate petition challenges the FAA's July 28 national drone-delivery PEA/FONSI/ROD (filed September 28, 2026, by fifteen states and Harris County). No later ruling or stay was verified in this sweep. The Westborough zoning appeal is an administrative local appeal, not a separate federal court challenge.
methodology: Targeted monthly source sweep of FAA environmental-review records, federal rulemaking, municipal announcements and meeting records, state and local reporting, and court-challenge coverage. Prefer primary government/court records, then direct local reporting. Track each documented development, not every affected municipality or every public comment. Absence of a record is not proof of no complaints or litigation. Separate proposed, first-read, withdrawn, and adopted local measures; do not infer a permit denial from a bill that failed for lack of a motion.
